newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere A shares hit record low.
newsitem.headline: Solidere A shares hit record low.

text.p: Solidere A shares hit an all-time low on Friday on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE), closing at $10.25 from Thursday's $10.75.

The A shares, which began trading on the Beirut Secondary Market at $111 in June 1994, last hit an all-time low of $103 on August 16, 1996 -- or $10.3 after Solidere's 10-for-one stock split which took effect earlier this month.
It was the first time the A shares hit a record low since the company moved it shares to the Beirut Stock Exchange on September 30.
Solidere B shares rose to $11.25 on Friday from $10.75 a day earlier.
